attachments.origin_landmark: external surfaces of ribs 5-12 (interdigitating with serratus anterior and latissimus dorsi)
attachments.insertion_landmark: iliac crest (anterior half of the outer lip), inguinal ligament, and linea alba via the aponeurosis

actions: laterally flexes and contralaterally rotates trunk (unilateral)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Fibers run obliquely inferomedially ('hands in pockets' direction) -- the most superficial of the three flat abdominal wall layers, and the layer whose fiber direction most differs from transversus abdominis's purely transverse fibers deep to it.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Transverse, in the mid-axillary line between the costal margin and the iliac crest -- the classic transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block window.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Most superficial of the three flat lateral wall muscles.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: Three parallel hyperechoic fascial layers over muscle bellies that thin from posterolateral to anterior; fibers run inferomedially ('hands in pockets' direction).
structures_at_risk: intercostal/subcostal neurovascular bundle between the internal oblique and transversus abdominis, one layer deep
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Injected as part of the same lateral-wall preoperative botulinum toxin protocol as internal oblique and transversus abdominis (see those entries) before complex ventral hernia repair.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Quevedo-Cruz D et al., Hernia 30:75 (2026), doi:10.1007/s10029-025-03558-7 -- ultrasound-guided botulinum toxin prehabilitation technique for complex ventral hernia (PubMed); Zamkowski M et al., Pol Przegl Chir 97(6):1 (2025), doi:10.5604/01.3001.0055.3078 -- volumetric muscle elongation by layer after lateral wall injection (PubMed)
